verdict.rationale: Vast.ai publishes a REST API reference section (api-reference/introduction) and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec that returns HTTP 200, which supports tool-generated or interactive exploration. Concrete copyable CLI/SDK examples also exist. However, nothing in the evidence shows an in-browser 'try it' console or runnable examples embedded in the API reference itself. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-docs API playground, runnable per-endpoint request examples, independent/hands-on corroboration.
